results.content: # Building A Self Evolving Agent. This whole project started because I read a post about a 200 line coding project that let an AI agent have access to its source, could add the features it wanted according to its goals, and recompile itself. Each agent is an autonomous AI persona with its own identity, goals, memory, tactics, and schedule. Agents run evolution cycles, researching, producing output, improving their own tools, and journaling their progress, all without human intervention. Agents can also **request their own scheduling.**. Agents choose their cycle intensity each run:. Agents save their thinking state at the end of each cycle, current focus, open threads, blockers, confidence level, cycle type, dimensional self-grades, expertise tags, and scheduling hints. Each agent gets an auto-computed growth summary showing: cycle count, average grade, trend direction (↑/↓/steady), and creator reaction counts. The system tracks output quality grades over time: if an agent’s grades are declining, it auto-injects corrective feedback. Agents can search their own past journal, learnings, scratchpad, and outputs.

By utilizing Darwin Gödel Machine (DGM) patterns, it allows agents to sample, mutate, and evaluate their own logic against performance benchmarks. It features long-term memory architectures for continual learning and multi-agent co-evolution patterns, making it an essential tool for developers and researchers building sophisticated autonomous systems that need to adapt to complex tasks without manual intervention. ## Key Features. ## Use Cases. `npx skillfish add plurigrid/asi self-evolving-agent`.
